title: Onboard Celestia-7B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Nair
description: This PR adds Celestia-7B v1.0 to the model registry with full metadata, performance profiles for supported runtime configurations, and automation to emit changelog/release notes entries. Motivation: Celestia is a community model we benchmarked in perf-lab; onboarding it enables customers to select optimized profiles for hosted and Dedicated deployments and ensures the changelog is populated automatically when performance metadata changes. Changes include: model metadata (format, licensing, tokenizer), perf profiles for fp16/quant/int8 candidates (latency/throughput/SLO guidance), a lightweight changelog-generation script integrated into the registry CI, and tests + docs. Checklist: [x] Add metadata JSON and README entry; [x] Add perf profiles (fp16, q4_0); [x] Add changelog automation script and CI job; [x] Add integration tests to validate registry ingestion; [x] Add example usage snippet for SDKs. Testing performed: local perf runs on perf-canary (A100 single-node), CI unit + integration, registry ingestion test in a dockerized environment. Rollout plan: merge -> registry index update -> nightly canary run to sanity-check perf profiles -> public announcement once canary passes. Follow-ups: plan to add a quantized 4-bit int8 profile after additional stability runs (ENG-4987).
